item.title: java code base spring security setting with gradle
item.description:
java code base spring security setting github 리파지토리
build.gradle에 다음을 추가

repositories {
    mavenCentral()
    maven {
        url "http://repo.springsource.org/snapshot"
    }
}

dependencies {
def springSecurityVersion = "3.1.4.RELEASE"
compile "org.springframework.security:spring-security-core:$springSecurityVersion"
    compile "org.springframework.security:spring-security-web:$springSecurityVersion"
    compile "org.springframework.security:spring-security-config:$springSecurityVersion"
compile "org.springframework.security:spring-security-javaconfig:1.0.0.CI-SNAPSHOT"
}
